notes: Positive: tech-spec / design-doc / RFC / documento técnico requests for a specific feature/system. Negative: PRD authoring, code implementation, ADR (single decision), test plan, code review, full dev plan / sub-task breakdown. Edge: lite spec; spec without PRD (pure-platform work).

Necesito el documento técnico para el módulo de pagos
Draft a design doc for the migration to event sourcing
RFC for upgrading Postgres from 14 to 16 — platform-only work, no PRD
Diseño técnico para el feature de búsqueda con pgvector
Translate this PRD into engineering reality — full tech spec please
Lite tech spec for adding the new `is_redeemable` column — minimal sections only
Engineering design doc for the new fraud-detection service
Write the PRD for the new payment-experience initiative
Implement the discount-redeem-v2 service in TypeScript
Write an ADR for choosing Postgres over DynamoDB
cases.notes: Single decision = ADR skill; spec assembles many ADRs.

Review this PR for code quality issues

cases.notes: Dev plan = development-plan skill / tech-lead agent.

cases.notes: Threat model skill; spec might reference it but doesn't author.

Lite tech spec — just summary, architecture, contracts, rollout, and risks. Nothing else.

cases.notes: Fires, but the skill should explicitly flag risk of drafting without final PRD.
